description: Hot observable that is also an observer: `next()` multicasts a value to all current subscribers.
Subject with a current value (`.value`) that is replayed to every new subscriber.
Replays the last `n` values to new subscribers.
Returns a read-only observable view of a Subject, hiding `next()`.
Multicasts a cold source and replays the latest values; use `refCount: true` to unsubscribe when nobody listens.
